explanation: Populate the accepted source/harness/input snapshot at execution time: the real runner captures it immediately after identity is accepted (before any build/run) and threads it through _record, and the fake runner captures it when building its record. ExecutionRecord carries it (and serializes it). register_dynamic_reproduction now freezes record.source_digests and re-checks the current files via source_digests_hold, so a mutate/delete after execution but before registration forbids authority, while unchanged controls and empty synthetic snapshots with explicit test-only promotion still confirm. Final-use liveness already re-checks the same minted digests. Binary-liveness untouched.
